slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
“宋荞，你不就是想要得到我吗？！我给你就是了！”
一道充满了屈辱的声音响了起来。
叽叽喳喳说什么呢！
宋荞揉了揉发疼的眉眼，一睁眼就看见一个面目俊朗却满面不甘的男子，正朝着她走过来。
男子咬着牙，将手放在她的肩膀上：“我会娶你，会和你结成道侣。也会……把我自己给你。唯一的条件，你不能再追究林颜的责任，你还要告诉所有人，这灵兽蛋，是你主动让给她的。
否则……这辈子，你都休想让我再多看你一眼。”
宋荞顿时瞳孔地震了起来。
什么情况！
她忙工作忙昏头了？不就是连续加班三天三夜吗，也不至于出现这种幻觉吧！
宋荞不说话，男子以为她默认了。他的脸上，带着视死如归的神情，眸底满是痛楚。
他颤抖着，将宋荞的衣服往下拉。
为了颜儿，他可以奉献出所有。
宋荞可以得到他的身体，却永远得不到他的心。
颜儿知道了，一定也会谅解他的。
宋荞：“”？？？？”
她虽然还没搞清楚情况。但是……她的手怎么突然有点痒！
宋荞伸手，毫不犹豫在他脸上打了一个巴掌！
啪！清脆的声音响起，男子愣了一下，有些难以置信地看着宋荞：“宋荞，你敢打我？我都愿意和你睡了，你还有什么不满意的！”
这什么雷霆发言！
宋荞冷笑了一声，正要怒骂。

下一刻。
她的脑海中，响起了一道无比清脆的声音。
“生子系统已启动。剧情高速载入中。”
宋荞懵了。
啥？啥子？？
生子系统？？？
还不等她质问，海量的信息，瞬间涌入到了她的脑海中。
她竟是穿越了！而且还穿越到了一本书的世界中。
这本书叫做《御兽成神，女主她有锦鲤命》。
这本书的女主林颜，她有着天生的锦鲤命，而且，修为越强，锦鲤命越明显。到书中大后期的时候，她出门就能捡到神器，随便喊一声，就有一堆神兽哭着喊着求她契约。
如果穿的是女主，这剧情堪称是爽爽爽。
但偏偏……她穿的是恶毒女配宋荞！
宋荞父母早亡，从小跟着爷爷长大。爷爷宋方，是灵心宗的大长老，化神境界的顶尖强者。
偏偏宋荞，却资质平庸。宋方给她找遍了各种资源，她还是一直徘徊在练气期。
宋方寿数将尽，为了让孙女未来在这吃人的修仙界能有个依靠，他收下了一个弟子，这弟子，便是方才出现的男子，名为楚风眠。
宋方倾尽资源培养楚风眠，要求只有一个，就是在他走后，帮他照顾宋荞。
楚风眠当时，十分爽快就答应了下来。之后他对女配更是极尽温柔体贴之事，时时刻刻都将她捧在手心上。
女配慢慢地，便将一颗心都给了楚风眠。两人渐渐开始形影不离，成了宗门公认的一对。
宋方对此也乐见其成，甚至因此对楚风眠加大了培养力度。
这个过程中，楚风眠从未表现过不满。他一边享受着女配的爱慕和崇拜，一边接受着宋方为他找来的各种资源。

直到……女主林颜的出现。
女主一进宗门，就吸引走了楚风眠的目光。
她天真可爱，活泼率真，唯一的缺点就是一点笨手笨脚。
content_en:
"Song Qiao, don't you just want me?! I'll give it to you!"
A voice full of humiliation sounded.
What are you talking about?
Song Qiao rubbed her sore eyebrows, and when she opened her eyes, she saw a handsome but unwilling man walking towards her.
The man gritted his teeth and put his hand on her shoulder: "I will marry you and become a Taoist partner with you. I will also...give myself to you. The only condition is that you can no longer hold Lin Yan responsible, and you have to tell everyone that you gave this spirit beast egg to her on your own initiative.
Otherwise...you will never let me look at you again in this life. "
Song Qiao's pupils suddenly trembled.
What's going on!
Is she too busy with work? Even if you work overtime for three days and three nights in a row, you won't have this kind of hallucination!
Song Qiao didn't say anything, and the man thought she acquiesced. There was a look of death on his face, and his eyes were full of pain.
He trembled and pulled Song Qiao's clothes down.
For Yan'er, he would give everything.
Song Qiao could get his body, but he could never get his heart.
If Yan'er knows, she will definitely forgive him.
Song Qiao: ""? ? ? ? "
Although she hasn't figured out the situation yet. But... why did her hands suddenly feel itchy?
Song Qiao reached out and slapped him on the face without hesitation!
Snap! A clear voice sounded, and the man was stunned for a moment, looking at Song Qiao in disbelief: "Song Qiao, you dare to hit me? I am willing to sleep with you, what else are you dissatisfied with! "
What kind of thunderous statement is this!
Song Qiao sneered and was about to curse.
The next moment.
An extremely clear voice sounded in her mind.
"The childbirth system has been activated. The plot is loading at high speed. "
Song Qiao was stunned.
What? What? ?
Subsystem? ? ?
Before she could question him, a massive amount of information poured into her mind instantly.
She actually traveled through time! And he also traveled to the world of a book.
This book is called "Becoming a God by Controlling Beasts, the Female Protagonist Has the Life of a Koi".
The heroine of this book, Lin Yan, has a natural destiny of koi carp, and the stronger her cultivation level, the more obvious her destiny of koi carp is. In the later stages of the book, she can pick up artifacts when she goes out. Just shout, and there will be a bunch of divine beasts crying and begging her to make a contract.
If the heroine was wearing the costume, the plot would be so cool.
But... she was wearing the vicious female partner Song Qiao!
Song Qiao's parents died young and he grew up with his grandfather. Grandpa Song Fang is the great elder of Lingxin Sect and a top expert in the realm of god transformation.
Song Qiao, however, has mediocre qualifications. Song Fang searched all kinds of resources for her, but she still lingered in the Qi training period.
Song Fang was coming to the end of his life. In order to let his granddaughter have someone to rely on in the future in this cannibalistic world of immortality, he accepted a disciple. This disciple was the man who just appeared, named Chu Fengmian.
Song Fang spent all his resources cultivating Chu Fengmian with only one request, which was to help him take care of Song Qiao after he left.
At that time, Chu Fengmian readily agreed. After that, he was even more gentle and considerate towards his female counterpart, holding her in his hands at all times.
The female supporting role slowly gave her heart to Chu Fengmian. The two gradually became inseparable and became a recognized couple in the sect.
Song Fang was also happy to see the success, and even increased his efforts to train Chu Fengmian because of this.
During this process, Chu Fengmian never showed dissatisfaction. While enjoying the love and admiration of his female partner, he also accepted the various resources that Song Fang found for him.
Until... the heroine Lin Yan appeared.
As soon as the heroine entered the sect, she attracted Chu Fengmian's attention.
She is innocent, cute, lively and outspoken, and her only flaw is that she is a little clumsy.
